title: Per-Person Weekend Staffing at Household Home Visits — Training Note
content:
**Training note, Specimen Collection Appointments — Mobile In-Home Collection Visit.**

At a weekend home visit where household members were drawn, the weekend amount is charged by the people drawn rather than once per visit. The rule reads the visit's fee record (whether it carries an assessed additional-patient fee) and the number of additional household members on the visit record.

**The clause.** When the visit carries an assessed additional-patient fee and two or more household members were drawn, the weekend amount is charged per person drawn at half a share each, that is multiplied by the number of people drawn (the patient plus the members) and then by 0.50; when the visit carries an assessed additional-patient fee and exactly one member was drawn, the weekend amount is multiplied by 1.25; otherwise the weekend amount is charged once per visit.

| Assessed additional-patient fee on the visit | Members drawn | Effect on the weekend amount |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Two or more | Multiplied by (1 plus the members) and then by 0.50 |
| Yes | Exactly one | Multiplied by 1.25 |
| Otherwise | — | Charged once per visit (unchanged) |

**Worked multipliers (hypothetical visits).**

| Members drawn | People drawn | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 2 | 1.25 |
| 2 | 3 | 3 multiplied by 0.50, that is 1.50 |
| 3 | 4 | 4 multiplied by 0.50, that is 2.00 |

A weekend amount of 50.00 at a visit with three members drawn and an assessed additional-patient fee on the record becomes 100.00 at this point.
